title: Workspace Triage Panel & Dynamic Sidebar Folding for cost-first navigation
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: As teams onboard to Redwood Console they juggle multiple workspaces, routes (dashboards, rollouts, cost views), and ad-hoc operations (canary rollouts, cost audits). The current left-rail is dense and forces deep navigation to reach cost and rollout surfaces. This ticket explores a compact, triage-first workspace dock plus a dynamic folding sidebar that surfaces cost and rollout affordances earlier in the path to reduce mean time-to-insight and lower context-switch friction.

This ticket covers research synthesis, low-fi and hi-fi prototypes, interaction spec for fold/unfold states, routing patterns for deep links, and a review pass with PM/eng for feasibility and accessibility.
goals: Reduce clicks-to-cost-summary for workspace owners by 40%
Expose rollout and canary controls within one interaction from workspace switch
Create a consistent compact dock pattern that scales to 6+ workspace entries
Provide clear affordances for fold/unfold states and preserve keyboard navigation and screen-reader semantics
constraints: Must not add additional backend endpoints or change existing route semantics (use query params/route anchors)
Work within existing token-level analytics events (product instrumentation team constraint)
Design must degrade gracefully on narrow viewports and preserve console SLA banners and header actions
acceptance_criteria: Clickable prototype (Figma + interactive) demonstrating: compact dock, dynamic fold/unfold, hover preview for cost summary, direct routing to rollout canary modal
Design spec with CSS tokens, spacing, and 3 visual states (collapsed, compact, expanded)
Accessibility checklist: focus order, ARIA labels for workspace dock, contrast ratios >= AA
PM and Eng sign-off on routing approach and no new server-side dependencies
Usability test (5 participants) with median task completion < 45s for 'find cost breakdown' task
design_notes: Move from a monolithic left rail to a two-tier dock: primary workspace icons + contextual action strip
Contextual action strip surfaces cost, rollout, and alerts for the active workspace. On hover it expands to a compact summary card (3 metrics: spend, avg latency, SLO violations)
Fold behavior: user toggles persistent expanded state per workspace; keyboard shortcut option (G then W) mapped in console shortcut mapping
Routing: deep links use /workspaces/:id?panel=cost or ?panel=rollout to maintain backward compatibility with existing routes
Fallbacks: on unsupported browsers, dock renders as a simple list and the contextual strip appears as a popover

2026-03-09 - Ethan Park (ENG): Eng review — routing using query param panels is feasible. Raised two follow-ups: (1) analytics event changes required to correlate 'dock-open -> cost-hover' sequences (ENG-1954), (2) lazy-load of cost summary data to avoid extra latency (ENG-2010).
2026-03-11 - Design review: Accessibility pass completed. Added ARIA roletype and outlined focus states for expanded/collapsed dock. Pending an a11y test with VoiceOver and NVDA.

2026-03-12 - Liam Chen: Hi-fi prototype uploaded to Storybook and demo scheduled for 2026-03-15 design review with PM/ENG/GO-to-market. Added notes to PRD (Confluence) for rollout phasing and telemetry.
